questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The wounded man was being helped by a few men.

options.text: The wounded man had been helped by a few men.
A few men were helping the wounded man.
The wounded man was helping a few men.
A few men are helping the wounded man.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **A few men were helping the wounded man.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and we need to change it into the active **form**.
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive form of the Past Continuous Tense.
 
• The Past Continuous Tense in the passive voice has the following structure: Object+ was/were +being+V3+ by + subject__
 
• The Past Continuous Tense in the active voice has the following structure: __Subject + was/were + v1+ing+ object__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Passive voice - *The wall was being painted by Rahul.*
 
• Active voice - *Rahul was painting the wall.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Active Voice: *A few men were helping the wounded man.*

questions.question:

By whom was grammar taught to you?

options.text: Did he teach you grammar?
Who had taught you grammar?
You were taught grammar by whom?
Who taught you grammar?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence** "By whom was grammar taught to you?"** is in** the passive voice**.
 
• To express it in the active voice, we need to identify the subject performing the action (who) and place it at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• The structure in active voice would be **"Who taught you grammar?"**
 
• In this construction,** "who"** is the subject,** "taught"** is the verb, and** "you"** is the object.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Who taught you grammar?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 2: **"Who had taught you grammar?" - Incorrect tense (past perfect instead of simple past).
 
• **Option 3: **"You were taught grammar by whom?" - This is in the passive voice and merely rephrases the original question without changing the voice.

• **Passive Format: Subject + have/has been + past participle (V3) + (by + **agent).
 
• **Active Format: Subject + have/has + past participle (V3).**
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Passive example: The letter has been mailed.
 
• Active example: Someone has mailed the letter.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***"Someone has cleaned the utensils."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
